advice_items.quote: My first collection I did with $500 and then I was able to write some orders, I had a decent amount of margin, I was able to reinvest in the business.
advice_items.summary_en: Start lean with minimal capital and reinvest healthy margins back into growth.
advice_items.summary_zh: 小额启动并把利润持续再投入

advice_items.quote: Keep your head down, build a profitable business, not just a business that looks good top line. You got to have EBITDA, baby.
advice_items.summary_en: Focus on building actual profitability and EBITDA rather than vanity top-line revenue.
advice_items.summary_zh: 重视盈利能力与EBITDA而非虚胖营收

advice_items.quote: Don't be intimidated by the men in suits... I had to have that confidence within myself to know I know what I'm talking about.
advice_items.summary_en: Have unshakeable self-confidence and refuse to be intimidated in any room.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持自信不被西装大佬气场吓倒

advice_items.quote: Don't go to any negotiation or any contract negotiation without doing your homework. Know exactly who is going to be sitting in that room.
advice_items.summary_en: Listen closely and research the other party thoroughly so you can surprise them in negotiations.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谈判前做足背调以信息差出奇制胜

guests.first_money_or_break: 用500美元启动首个饰品系列，靠订单利润再投资与信用卡负债苦撑10年自力更生，直到门店大排长龙后风投和私募才主动找上门。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Her mentor ("If you build it, they will come")
Her father ("Don't be intimidated by the men in suits")
guests.role_or_title: Founder of Kendra Scott (Jewelry & Accessories Brand)

advice_items.quote: Everything that you want is on the other side of your ego. You got to get your ego out of the way.
advice_items.summary_en: Remove your ego so it does not block your growth and success.
advice_items.summary_zh: 放下自我与傲慢才能达成目标

advice_items.quote: There's a hustle and a grind that's absolutely necessary that most people are not willing to put the effort into.
advice_items.summary_en: Recognize that entrepreneurship demands relentless hustle and grind most people will not endure.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业需要常人难以承受的拼搏与磨砺

advice_items.quote: I have a system and process that gives me all data... I have people that I empower and then they run the same system across every single company.
advice_items.summary_en: Build replicable data-driven systems and empower people to run them across multiple businesses.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用可复制的系统和授权团队批量扩张

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: Right now, AI and tech... because it has the greatest opportunity for scale. Everyone knows they need it.
advice_items.summary_en: Target AI and technology for the greatest scalability and market demand.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选对AI与科技赛道获取最大规模红利

guests.first_money_or_break: 出身并不富裕，靠白手起家进入私募股权行业，2019年单年以12.7亿美元出售76家公司，现同时运营86家公司。
recommended_books_or_mentors: Ego Is the Enemy by Ryan Holiday

advice_items.canonical_tag: Choose the Right Industry / Big Market
advice_items.quote: I wanted to go in an industry that had a lot of white space where there was not a lot of competitors... the consolidation opportunity was really clear.
advice_items.summary_en: Pick industries with white space, low competition, low regulation, and clear consolidation potential.
advice_items.summary_zh: 选择竞争少且有整合空间的空白市场

advice_items.quote: Understanding that you're going to have good times and bad times, you got to find the middle and be comfortable with it.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay emotionally centered through business highs and lows rather than riding extremes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 在巅峰与低谷间保持平和稳定的心态

advice_items.quote: Hire people that are wicked smart that make you look stupid, because you're going to end up being the smartest person in the room for hiring them.
advice_items.summary_en: Hire people smarter than you who are willing to challenge you and tell you when you are wrong.
advice_items.summary_zh: 雇用比自己更聪明且敢于说不的人才

advice_items.quote: Wanting to be flashier than they should, thinking that perception of what they look like is more important than who they are.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid flashy status spending and prioritize real substance over outward perception.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别为虚荣炫富买单而应注重内在实力

advice_items.quote: Prove to them by having the right information, doing the right research, outworking them every single day, and never be entitled to anything... show up first and you leave last.
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome age barriers by doing the homework, dropping entitlement, and outworking everyone daily.
advice_items.summary_zh: 年轻人靠充分调研和最拼努力赢得席位

guests.first_money_or_break: 20年前看中竞争少、监管少且具备整合空间的房车（RV）行业，从零做到如今70亿美元规模、单年最高盈利9.8亿美元。
guests.zero_start_advice: 不要让年龄成为障碍，靠充分准备与调研、戒掉理所当然的心态、最早到最晚走地拼命工作来赢得一席之地。

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Control Money, Don't Let It Control You
advice_items.quote: Money's a great slave, but a horrible master.
advice_items.summary_en: Use money as a tool under your control rather than becoming controlled by it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 让金钱做你的好仆人而非坏主人

advice_items.quote: Pioneers get slaughtered and settlers prosper... you could be too early on something and nobody gets it... take my time, let me settle, let me figure it out.
advice_items.summary_en: Avoid being so early that the market rejects you; move deliberately and let things mature.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别盲目做过早的先驱而要稳健落地

advice_items.quote: If a bird lands on the branch, does the bird trust the branch or does it trust its wings?... Trust your wings.
advice_items.summary_en: Trust your own capabilities rather than relying on external safety nets.
advice_items.summary_zh: 相信自身羽翼而非依赖外在树枝

advice_items.quote: Deliberate clarity. You can't manage a secret.
advice_items.summary_en: Operate with deliberate clarity across your business because hidden issues cannot be managed.
advice_items.summary_zh: 保持刻意清晰才能有效管理业务

advice_items.quote: Start with a standard. What you accept, you can't change... you got to play to the standard.
advice_items.summary_en: Set a clear standard from the start because whatever you tolerate becomes permanent.
advice_items.summary_zh: 从一开始就立下不可妥协的高标准

advice_items.quote: You got to know your worth, know your value, you can't give freebies... if you pay me this $5,000, I'll make you $5 million.
advice_items.summary_en: Know your worth, stop giving away freebies, and frame your price as clear ROI for clients.
advice_items.summary_zh: 拒绝免费赠送并向客户讲清投资回报

guests.first_money_or_break: 5年前独立创业创办LinkedXL，通过咨询与软件业务，个人单年最高收入达100万至300万美元。
recommended_books_or_mentors: His mother ("Start with a standard; what you accept, you can't change")
guests.role_or_title: CEO of LinkedXL & Author of "The Winning Link"
guests.wealth_detail: $1M-$3M personal income in best single year
guests.zero_start_advice: 像鸟一样相信自己的翅膀而非树枝，坚守标准并清晰展现自己的价值回报。
